title: 'Hardness' of Samples Need to be Quantified for a Reliable Evaluation System: Exploring Potential Opportunities with a New Task

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model reliance on unintended input-output correlations by measuring model predictability and performance drops across IID and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) datasets (IMDB and SST-2) using Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) and the proposed WOOD Score.
